intl.title: NSU - International Undergraduate Admission (deadlines, English proficiency, 2026-27 cost estimate)

schol.title: NSU - International Student Scholarships and non-resident tuition waiver

test_policy.notes: The Admission Requirements page lists three routes (any one is enough): 2.70 four-year GPA with upper-50% class rank, 2.7 GPA in the 15 required courses, or ACT 20+ (or an SAT equivalent from a concordance table), and says applicants should have taken the ACT or a similar test. An older admissions FAQ mentions a test-optional pilot for students with a 2.7 GPA; scholarships still need scores. The international admissions page does not mention SAT/ACT.

requirements.notes: Online NSU application; $25 non-refundable fee, no fee waivers. International applicants send sealed official transcripts (at least 3 years of high school, with a 4.0-scale GPA) to the Office of International Programs and must show funds for the first year before an I-20/DS-2019 is issued (financial statement form, documents dated within 3 months). College credit earned outside the U.S. needs a WES or ECE course-by-course evaluation to transfer. Required high school units: 15 (4 English, 3 lab science, 3 math, 3 history/citizenship, 2 other).

deadlines.label: International application deadline, fall semester (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Admission Deadlines on the international page: Fall July 1, Spring Nov. 1; no summer or other international-specific date. The page prints no year, so fall 2027 is assumed.

deadlines.label: International incoming-student scholarship deadline, fall (fall 2027)
deadlines.notes: Presidential (3.75 GPA), Academic Excellence (3.0) and International Freshmen (2.75) scholarships; fall deadline July 1, spring Nov. 1; applications go to international@nsuok.edu.

deadlines.label: Non-resident 50% tuition waiver, fall 2027 starters
deadlines.notes: Summer starters June 1, fall starters Aug. 1 (Spring 2027 starters Jan. 1). Incoming freshmen need a 3.0 minimum GPA and must live on campus (exceptions for legacy students).

deadlines.label: General Foundation Scholarship final deadline (new international students, 2027-2028)
deadlines.notes: Priority College Committee deadline March 1, 2027; final General Committee deadline May 1, 2027.

english_policy.waiver_notes: One of TOEFL, IELTS, PTE Academic or iTEP Academic is required for international applicants; applicants with more than 24 credit hours at a U.S. university are exempt. The page mentions no Duolingo or Cambridge option, no conditional admission and no ESL pathway.

english.notes: Institution code 6485. The page does not give the new 1-6 scale.
PTE Academic. iTEP Academic 3.5 is also accepted (no separate field here).

cost.notes: NSU's 2026-27 F-1/J-1 estimate: tuition and fees (out-of-state, 30 credit hours) $18,367.50, international fees $300 (plus a one-time $50 orientation fee), health insurance about $1,000, books $800, housing and food $9,020; estimated total $29,537.50 (rounded to dollars here; the total includes the insurance and one-time fee). Non-resident tuition is $334.25 per undergraduate credit hour. The in-state rate is not on the pages read (College Navigator 2024-25: $7,810 in-state, $17,290 out-of-state).

aid.notes: One-year international scholarships by GPA: Presidential (3.75) $2,000-$5,000, Academic Excellence (3.0) $1,000-$2,000, International Freshmen (2.75) $500-$1,000; applicants need a 2.75 GPA and full degree-program admission. A non-resident 50% tuition waiver (half of the $334.25 per-credit non-resident tuition) requires a 3.0 GPA for freshmen and living on campus. The 2024-2025 CDS (H6) reports no institutional aid awarded to nonresidents that year (0 recipients), so published awards are competitive and not guaranteed.

sat.note: The international admissions page does not print an SAT code; look it up in the College Board code search.

act.note: No ACT code is printed on the pages read; look it up at act.org.

toefl.note: NSU TOEFL institution code; official report can also be mailed to 600 N Grand Avenue, Tahlequah, OK 74464.

duolingo.note: Duolingo is not listed as an accepted test on the page read.
